channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: xLib Fork
item.description: XLib provides an interface to add skills, abilities and effects to the game.

item.title: xSkills Fork
item.description: RPG-style skill system with abilities, perks, and progression.

item.title: Fornax
item.description: The kiln between the pit kiln and the beehive kiln. Mud brick, firewood, and no iron at all.

item.title: Crucibulum
item.description: Set a crucible in the forge and melt metal where you smith it

item.title: Magical Moon - FRustyMagic (Beta)
item.description: An entirely in-world, small, moon magic mod. Play around with beams of light!

item.title: VintageSymphonyForked
item.description: Vintage Symphony is a situation-aware music engine replacement for Vintage Story, forked for 1.22

item.title: Komet - Performance Mod
item.description: Komet is a performance mod, which optimizes the Vintage Story rendering.

item.title: Olla
item.description: Bring ancient irrigation technology to Vintage Story! This mod adds ollas (pronounced "oy-yahs")

item.title: Metal Bowls Mod (for more bowls)
item.description: Adds metal bowls

item.title: Jack's Ladder
item.description: Changes the shape of the ladder to accommodate for gaps.

item.title: Rustmatica EasyPlace
item.description: Addon to Rustmatica, streamlining the building process of schematics

item.title: Rustmatica
item.description: A building assistant mod that allows you to save, load and visualize block structures

item.title: Packrat
item.description: Unified Storage Browser showing the contents of all chests and crates within reach

item.title: Place it Anywhere
item.description: Place any item as decoration on floors, walls and ceilings. Up to 64 items per cell.

item.title: C&N Player Skills
item.description: TFC-style skills

item.title: Muppers Arcana
item.description: A book-learned magic mod: find spellbooks in ruins and from traders and learn powers.

item.description: This mod adds 4 rideable dragons that the player can hatch and raise from eggs found in the wild

item.title: Wilderlands World Seeder Utility
item.description: - A utility mod that adds a system for "seeding" blocks and entities into the world.

item.title: Immersive Fibercraft
item.description: Adds new immersive spinning and weaving crafting mechanics to VintageStory! Try the new loom!

item.title: Player Model NPCs
item.description: Placeable NPCs that can use any PlayerModelLib model, plus in-game activity and dialogue editor

item.title: W4RD0's Furniture
item.description: A furniture pack adding detailed furniture like tables, chairs, couches, beds, shelves & a lot more.

item.title: Auto Walk Extended
item.description: Toggle walking/running. Options for sneak toggle, stepup and mouse button lock.

item.title: MealRecipeLagFix
item.description: Fixes handbook lag when browsing meal recipe pages.

item.title: Fennel Swag
item.description: Adds some features for fennel because it isn't any good

item.title: FendragonBCS
item.description: Fendragon Backpack Construction System - this mod add construction system for backpack

item.title: FendragonPlayerTimeReward
item.description: Tracks real online time per player and gives rewards at configured minute

item.title: FendragonSMC
item.description: FendragonSMC - mod is part of the Fendragon mod ecosystem and is developed exclusively for server

item.title: Fendragon Blacksmith Gloves
item.description: FendragonBlacksmithGloves - that mod adds blacksmith gloves with practical quality-of-life bonuses

item.title: RemoveStructures
item.description: Change chances of worldgen:structures.json

item.title: Tallybook
item.description: Crafting shopping list, quest tracker, story guide, and world/player reference. Fully client-side.
